name: Cambio Temporal de Color
description: Analiza desplazamientos temporales de color para detectar manipulación de video
algorithm: Color Temporal Shift — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects temporal color shifts in video for deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Color Canal Señal Extracción**: Per-frame mean values of R, G, B channels (and derived Lab, HSV values) are extracted separately for face and background regions. These form temporal color signals tracking the color evolution of each region over time.

2. **Drift Rate Análisis**: The rate of color change across frames is computed. Natural video shows either stable colors (controlled lighting) or smooth drifts (changing daylight). Deepfakes may introduce subtle but detectable frame-to-frame color oscillations as the generator independently determines color for each frame.

3. **Rostro - Background Color Coupling**: In authentic video, face and background color signals are physically coupled — both respond to the same illumination changes. The method measures temporal correlation between face and background color channels. Low correlation indicates the face is generated independently, lacking physical illumination coupling with the background.

4. **Color Temperature Consistencia**: The correlated color temperature (CCT) of illumination is estimated per frame from color channel ratios. Natural lighting produces consistent CCT across all scene regions. Deepfake faces may be rendered with different effective color temperature than the background, creating detectable inter-region CCT disagreement.

5. **Espectral Análisis of Color Signals**: The temporal color signals are analyzed via FFT. Natural color variation shows specific spectral characteristics (low-frequency illumination changes, camera AGC periodicity). AI-generated color variation may show different spectral signatures — higher-frequency fluctuations from frame-independent rendering or aliased patterns from the generation process.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante color temporal shift analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
